summary: End-to-end verification of the new Cash-Out / Championship Prize / Manual Cash-Out system. Backend pytest suite (8 tests, all PASS) covers flag gating, over-withdraw, request lifecycle, admin mark-paid idempotency, reject-releases-tokens, and security (normal user cannot hit admin endpoints; /cashout/requests never returns full account_number). Frontend Playwright drove the full UX: disabled -> Coming Soon; admin toggle ON + review URLs saved; user cash-out modal 3-step flow (£20 -> bank add/select -> confirm -> success screen with WD-ID + Google & Trustpilot review links); wallet reflects Available -> £30 -> £10 with 'Pending cash out: £20'; admin filter processing, detail modal showing full bank payout, mark-paid, and reject-with-reason all succeed. Wallet math verified: Tokens = Total - Bonus (379 = 379 - 0). Regression: token top-up (+) button still present, transaction history renders, login flows unaffected. Flag reset to OFF at end.

issues: On initial mount the Wallet card renders all-zeros (Total 0, Tokens 0, Bonus 0, £0.00) for ~200-500ms before the /cashout/summary call resolves — a subtle flash. Consider a skeleton or hiding numbers until summary loads.
Toggle uses window.confirm and reject uses window.prompt — functional but not on-brand vs the rest of the admin (shadcn dialogs are used elsewhere).

Two overlapping concepts on same page: purple 'TOKEN BALANCE' hero (379 tokens) and new 'Wallet' breakdown card just below (Total Tokens 379). Slightly redundant — could unify or clearly re-label the hero.

action_items: (Optional polish) Hide zero-state numbers on CashOutCard until first summary load resolves (small loading state) to avoid the flash.
(Optional polish) Replace window.confirm / window.prompt in CashOutAdmin with shadcn dialogs for on-brand UX.
critical_code_review_comments: cashout_routes.py: reserve_withdrawable is called BEFORE the insert of the cashout_requests record. If the DB write fails after reserving, tokens would stay reserved without a linked request. Low-risk (Mongo insert is atomic and next line), but consider wrapping in try/except-release for defense-in-depth.

cashout_routes.py: mark_paid and reject rely on 'status=processing' guard for idempotency — this is correct, but a repeat mark-paid returns 200 with 'idempotent: True' regardless of whether the final status is 'paid' or 'rejected'. If a request was rejected and admin later hits mark-paid it will silently return 'rejected, idempotent'. Consider distinguishing 'not-in-processing' from truly idempotent.
CashOutCard.jsx: cashoutAPI.myRequests() and banks() both re-fetched on every load() call after each add/submit — fine at current scale, but if history grows large consider paginating.
CashOutAdmin.jsx: no debounce/limit on RefreshCw button; multiple fast clicks can queue duplicate loads.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functionally verified via UI (all data-testids present, all flows completed, screenshot evidence)

seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ bank accounts added for player1; several WD-* cashout requests created and processed (paid/rejected) during testing. Player1 wallet ended at Total 379, Bonus 0, Available £10 (from 50 seeded — £20 paid, £20 pending settled, plus rejects released). Flag reset to OFF at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cash-Out feature backend & frontend fully verified in iteration 42. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cashout_iter42.py can be re-run any time. Only cosmetic polish items remain (loading state on wallet card, shadcn dialogs instead of window.confirm/prompt in admin). player1 available balance is now around £10 (down from the seeded £50) due to test-driven paid withdrawals.
